The '''Xc-84 Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] developed by the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The bipedal [[Droid/Legends|droids]] armed with [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] were used by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to guard the [[Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
